character: A calm, editorial reading room for one author's HTML reports and the small community that reads and discusses them. The site's own chrome recedes: warm paper and ink neutrals, one confident blue, hairline cards and no shadows, so the report in its frame is what the eye lands on. The admin side is the same room for one expert. It is denser and tabular, and danger is kept rare and unmistakable.

colours.name: --bg
colours.use: Page background on html, behind everything that is not a card. Warm paper in light, warm near-black in dark.

colours.name: --surface
colours.use: The raised surface: site header bar, panels and cards, the data table, text inputs, neutral buttons.

colours.name: --surface-2
colours.use: The sunken surface: table header row and row hover, author-reply blocks, empty states, inline code, the avatar placeholder, the hover fill of neutral and quiet buttons.

colours.name: --text
colours.use: Body text, headings, logins, nav links, text on notices and tints. 15.9:1 on --bg (light), 15.3:1 (dark); 14.7:1 and 12.2:1 on --surface-2.

colours.name: --text-muted
colours.use: Hints, meta lines, times, bylines, table headers, dt labels, disclosure text, empty-state text. Worst case on --surface-2: 5.62:1 (light), 6.35:1 (dark).

colours.name: --border
colours.use: Edges of controls: buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, the file-selector button. At least 3:1 on every surface: light 3.32 (surface-2), 3.60 (bg), 3.89 (surface); dark 3.40, 4.26, 3.89.

colours.name: --divider
colours.use: Decorative hairlines: card edges, the header's bottom edge, table rules, report frame edge, list separators, avatar ring. Never the only edge of a control.

colours.name: --thread
colours.use: The 1px reply line down the left of .replies. Decorative structure, a step stronger than --divider.

colours.name: --link
colours.use: Every link and link-like text. Visited links are the same colour. Light 6.63:1 on bg, 6.13:1 on surface-2; dark 8.83:1 and 7.04:1.

colours.name: --accent
colours.use: Primary button fill, badge text, the author-reply edge, the brand mark, accent-color for native checkboxes. 7.17:1 (light) and 8.06:1 (dark) as a fill against --surface.

colours.name: --accent-hover
colours.use: Primary button fill on hover, and the link colour while pressed (:active).

colours.name: --on-accent
colours.use: Text on an --accent or --accent-hover fill. 7.17:1 and 9.06:1 (light); 8.04:1 and 10.19:1 (dark).

colours.name: --accent-soft
colours.use: Fill of the Author badge and of ::selection. --accent on it: 6.16:1 (light), 6.90:1 (dark). --text on it: 14.8:1 and 11.9:1.

colours.name: --danger
colours.use: Fill of the danger buttons; text of the Remove and Block summaries and of the blocked badge; the edge of the confirm tray and of error notices. Light 6.08:1 on bg, 5.62:1 on surface-2, 5.78:1 on danger-soft; dark 9.39, 7.49 and 7.89.

colours.name: --danger-hover
colours.use: Danger button fill on hover. --on-danger on it: 8.66:1 (light), 10.91:1 (dark).

colours.name: --on-danger
colours.use: Text on a --danger fill. 6.57:1 (light), 8.61:1 (dark).

colours.name: --danger-soft
colours.use: Fill of the error notice, the confirm tray and the blocked badge. --text on it: 15.1:1 and 12.8:1.

colours.name: --ok
colours.use: Success: the left edge of the 'Sent to the author.' notice and of .notice.ok. On ok-soft: 6.16:1 (light), 8.01:1 (dark).

colours.name: --ok-soft
colours.use: Fill of success notices. --text on it: 15.1:1 (light), 11.9:1 (dark).

colours.name: --warning
colours.use: Warning: the edge of .notice.warning. No screen uses it today; it exists so a later warning has a designed home. On warning-soft: 5.75:1 (light), 8.50:1 (dark); on bg 5.86:1 and 10.8:1.

colours.name: --warning-soft
colours.use: Fill of .notice.warning. --text on it: 15.6:1 (light), 12.0:1 (dark).

colours.name: --focus
colours.use: The keyboard focus ring on every focusable element, and the border of a focused input. At least 3:1 on every surface (light 6.13 or more, dark 7.04 or more).

colours.name: Canvas (system colour, not a token)
colours.use: The background-color of iframe only. It reproduces the browser's own canvas behind a report whose scheme matches the frame's, so the site surface never shows through the report.

type.name: --font-sans
type.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif
type.use: Everything: body, headings, controls (set explicitly on button, input, select and textarea, never by font: inherit). Only installed fonts: nothing is fetched, and CSP default-src 'self' would refuse a webfont anyway.

type.name: --font-mono
type.value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, Menlo, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
type.use: Inline code (the target="_blank" hint on the upload form) and any later pre.

type.name: --text-xs
type.use: Badges, table header cells, the uppercase eyebrow h3 in blocked-account cards

type.name: --text-sm
type.use: Bylines, hints, meta lines, labels, buttons, nav, disclosures, table body, dt, notices' small text, the file input

type.name: --text-md
type.use: Body text, comment bodies, inputs, selects and textareas (16px so phones do not zoom on focus), page-level empty states. html, body, main, section, article, .comment, .comments, .body and .replies never set a font-size.

type.name: --text-lg
type.use: h3, report card titles, the brand, stats (likes, comment count, tallies), blocked-account headings

type.name: weights
type.use: 400 for text and inputs. 600 for labels, buttons, disclosures, logins, stats, h2, h3, th, dt and badges. 700 for h1 and the brand.

type.name: --leading-tight
type.use: Headings, buttons, inputs, bylines, badges (1.4 for badges)

type.name: tracking
type.value: h1 -0.015em; h2 and brand -0.01em; table header .04em uppercase; eyebrow h3 .06em uppercase; badge .02em
type.use: Tightens large type and opens small caps

type.name: numerals
type.use: Stats (.likes, .comment-count, .tally), the data table, dd values, the report card numbers line

type.name: headings
type.value: text-wrap: balance on h1, h2 and h3
type.use: Long report titles break into even lines

space.name: --space-1
space.use: Byline to body, the tray's top margin, gap inside a report card, row gap in bylines

space.name: --space-2
space.use: Label to its field, gap between buttons, column gap in bylines, chevron to text, header vertical padding

space.name: --space-3
space.use: Textarea to its button, notice and tray padding, author-reply padding, list item padding, quiet button side padding

space.name: --space-4
space.use: Button side padding, gap between cards and between form rows, nav gap, own-feedback separators

space.name: --space-5
space.use: Before h3 and eyebrows, below the meta line, between stats, the dl column gap, page-level empty-state side padding

space.name: --space-6
space.use: Between page sections: votes, feedback, comments, inbox, moderation, and every h2's top margin

space.name: --space-7
space.use: Vertical padding of page-level empty states

space.name: --panel-pad
space.use: Padding inside every panel and card

space.name: --control-h
space.use: Minimum height of every button, input, select, file-selector button, disclosure summary, toggle and continue link. This is the tap target.

space.name: gutter
space.use: The page's side gutter at every width: 32px in total, which the 360px thread model reads. Never a token or calc() there.

space.name: page widths
space.use: Centred columns. 48rem is for the Not allowed page and any later plain page.

space.name: header inset
space.use: Puts the header's content on the same edges as the 70rem reader and admin content at every width

space.name: measure
space.value: 46rem, written as a literal in rules because .comments is a thread box
space.use: Reading measure, left-aligned in the wide column: .votes, .feedback, .comments, .legend, .feedback-inbox, .moderation, .blocked-account, dl, main[data-hband-admin] > p, the upload form. Form rows inside the upload form: 32rem.

space.name: thread geometry (unchanged)
space.value: .replies margin-left .75rem + padding-left .5rem + 1px line = 21px per level; .comment margin 1rem 0
space.use: A level-5 body keeps 259px at 375 and 244px at 360

shape.name: --radius-sm
shape.use: Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, file-selector button, inline code, notices (right corners only), author-reply blocks, the confirm tray, inline empty states

shape.name: --radius
shape.use: Panels and cards, the data table, the detail list, both report frames, page-level empty states

shape.name: hairline
shape.use: Card and panel edges, the header's bottom edge, table rules, list separators, the report frame edge

shape.name: control edge
shape.use: Neutral buttons, inputs, selects, textareas, the file-selector button. Primary and danger buttons take a 1px edge in their own fill colour.

shape.name: notice edge
shape.value: 4px solid, in the notice's role colour, on the left only

shape.name: reply edge
shape.value: 3px solid var(--accent), on the left only

shape.name: thread line
shape.value: 1px solid var(--thread), on the left only

shape.name: tray edge
shape.use: The open confirm tray of the two-step Remove and Block

shape.name: focus ring
shape.use: Every :focus-visible element. Text inputs also turn their border to --focus. Never removed.

shape.name: avatar ring
shape.use: Avatars, so a dark or missing image still reads as a circle. This is the only box-shadow in the system.

shape.name: shadows
shape.use: Elevation comes from --surface against --bg plus a hairline. There are no translucent colours anywhere, and nothing on the report frames but border, radius and Canvas.

shape.name: pressed
shape.use: Every button and the file-selector button while :active. No transitions and no animations.

components.name: Site header
states: signed out: All reports + the primary Sign in with GitHub
signed in reader: All reports, avatar, muted 'Signed in as @login', quiet Sign out
owner: as signed in, plus the Admin link before Sign out
no avatar URL: the who text without an image
nav link hover: underline 1px at offset .2em
keyboard focus: the 2px --focus ring at offset 2px on the brand, each link and Sign out
39-character login: the who text breaks anywhere inside the nav, and the page never widens
brand-only (Not allowed page): the bar with the Brand alone
phone: the nav wraps onto a second row under the brand, left-aligned

components.name: Brand
components.look: 'hband' at --text-lg, weight 700, letter-spacing -0.01em, in --text with no underline. display inline-flex, align-items center, gap --space-2. Before it, a ::before 'band' mark: content '', 1rem by .375rem, --radius-pill, --accent fill.
states: hover: text unchanged and no underline; the mark takes --accent-hover
keyboard focus: the focus ring around the word and the mark

components.name: Link
components.look:
Colour --link; visited links are the same colour, never purple. Underline 1px at offset .2em. Written as :where(a) so every component can override it at no specificity cost. Variants:
- Nav link: --text, no underline.
- Card title link: --text, no underline, inside a report card h2.
- Back link (.back): inline-flex, with a left chevron ::before (the Disclosure chevron rotated 135deg).
- Continue link (.continue): --text-sm, 600, inline-flex, min-height --control-h.
states: hover: underline thickness 2px; nav and card-title links gain the underline
pressed (:active): colour --accent-hover
visited: unchanged
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Primary button
components.look: The one main action of a form. --accent fill, 1px --accent edge, --on-accent text at --text-sm weight 600, line-height --leading-tight. min-height --control-h, padding 0 --space-4, --radius-sm. Bound to: .primary, .signin (an anchor, made inline-flex with no underline), .comments > form button, .reply form button, .feedback form button, .feedback-inbox form button, form[action='/admin/reports'] button.
states: hover: --accent-hover fill and edge
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the --focus ring at offset 2px, with a --bg gap between ring and fill
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge, cursor not-allowed, no hover

components.name: Neutral button
components.look: The secondary action. Written as :where(button), with every state inside :where() so that class-bound buttons always win. --surface fill, 1px --border edge, --text at --text-sm weight 600, min-height --control-h, padding 0 --space-4, --radius-sm, cursor pointer. It never sets display. Used for Thumbs up, Thumbs down and Take back my vote, Sign out in the admin main and on the Not allowed page, Publish, Unpublish and Unblock.
states: hover: --surface-2 fill
pressed: edge --text-muted, translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the focus ring
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge, not-allowed

components.name: Quiet button
components.look: A ghost button for chrome: no fill, no border, --text at --text-sm weight 600, padding 0 --space-3, min-height --control-h, --radius-sm. Bound to .quiet and .site-header button (the header's Sign out).
states: hover: --surface-2 fill
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the focus ring

components.name: Danger button
components.look: The same metrics as the Primary button: --danger fill, 1px --danger edge, --on-danger text. Bound to button.danger (button only, so .notice.danger never takes it), .remove form button, .block form button and form[action$='/delete'] button. It comes after the primary rule.
states: hover: --danger-hover fill and edge
pressed: translateY(1px)
keyboard focus: the --focus ring (blue, so it never blends into the danger fill)
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge

components.name: Disclosure
components.look:
A text-button for summary and button.toggle: no fill, no border, padding 0, min-height --control-h, --text-sm weight 600, --text-muted.
- summary keeps display:flex with align-items center, gains width fit-content and max-width 100%, uses list-style none, and hides ::-webkit-details-marker.
- .toggle never sets display; the hidden guard owns it.
- The chevron is a ::before: content '', display inline-block, flex none, .45em square, 2px right and bottom borders in currentColor, rotate(-45deg) so it points right, margin-right --space-2, vertical-align middle.
- details[open] > summary::before and .toggle[aria-expanded='true']::before rotate(45deg), so they point down.
states: closed or folded: muted text, chevron pointing right ('Reply', 'Show replies')
open or expanded: chevron pointing down; the Reply summary turns --text ('Hide replies' when expanded)
hover: --text, underline at offset .2em, no fill
keyboard focus: the focus ring around the text
toggle before thread.js runs: not drawn (hidden guard)

components.name: Two-step destructive control
components.look:
<details class='remove|block'>, markup unchanged.
- Step 1 is the summary as a Disclosure in --danger, with a --danger chevron ('Remove', 'Block').
- Step 2, the open form, is a confirm tray: --danger-soft fill, 1px --danger edge, --radius-sm, padding --space-3, margin --space-1 0 --space-3, width fit-content, max-width 100%. It holds the Danger button ('Remove for everyone', 'Block @login').
No display is set on the details element.
states: closed: danger summary only
summary hover: danger text plus underline
open: the tray appears under the summary with the filled confirm
confirm hover: --danger-hover
keyboard focus: the ring on the summary, then on the confirm
at the depth cap (244px at 360): the tray and its button fit, and 'Block @<39 chars>' wraps inside the button

components.name: Text input
components.look: input[type=text] (and type-less inputs): --surface fill, 1px --border, --radius-sm, min-height --control-h, padding --space-2 --space-3, --text-md weight 400 in --font-sans, --text, line-height --leading-tight, max-width 100%. Inside a Form row it is width 100%.
states: hover: edge --text-muted
keyboard focus: edge --focus plus the focus ring
error (:user-invalid after the person has edited it): edge --danger
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted text, --divider edge
empty: no placeholder text; the label above says what goes in

components.name: Textarea
components.look: The same box as the Text input, plus line-height --leading, min-height 6rem and resize vertical. In comment, reply, feedback and inbox forms it is display block, width 100%, max-width 100% and margin 0 0 --space-3, through the pinned '.comments textarea, .feedback textarea, .feedback-inbox textarea {' rule. That rule no longer says font: inherit, so it never inherits a label's 600 weight.
states: hover: edge --text-muted
keyboard focus: edge --focus plus the focus ring
error (:user-invalid): edge --danger
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted

components.name: Select
components.look: The same box as the Text input. appearance is left as is, so Chrome keeps its own dropdown arrow, drawn in the current scheme. Width 100% inside a Form row.
states: hover: edge --text-muted
keyboard focus: edge --focus plus the ring
open: the browser's own list, in the scheme from color-scheme
disabled: --surface-2 fill, --text-muted

components.name: File picker
components.look: input[type=file]: --text-sm, --text-muted for 'No file chosen' and the chosen name, max-width 100%, justify-self start inside a Form row. Its ::file-selector-button is drawn as a Neutral button: --surface fill, 1px --border, --radius-sm, min-height --control-h, padding 0 --space-4, font inherit at weight 600, --text, margin-right --space-3.
states: hover: the selector button takes --surface-2
keyboard focus: the focus ring around the whole input
file chosen: its name in --text-muted beside the button
phone: the name wraps under the button and the input never exceeds the row

components.name: Checkbox and radio
components.look: Not in today's markup; designed for later. A native control, 1.125rem square, margin 0, accent-color --accent. Its label is a Form row variant: display inline-flex, align-items center, gap --space-2, weight 400 (label:has(> input[type=checkbox], > input[type=radio])).
states: checked: --accent fill drawn by the browser
keyboard focus: the focus ring
disabled: the browser's dimmed control and a --text-muted label

components.name: Form row
components.look: Every label wraps its control. label is display grid with gap --space-2, --text-sm, weight 600, --text: the label's words sit above the control and the control fills the row. In the upload form, each row is a p with margin 0 0 --space-4, each label is capped at 32rem, and the help paragraph (form[action='/admin/reports'] p:not(:has(label, button))) is --text-sm --text-muted.
states: field error: the field's danger edge (:user-invalid)
refused by the server: the danger Notice above the form (p.error, role=alert), with the form refilled
keyboard focus: the field's ring; the label is unchanged

components.name: Panel
components.look: The card: --surface fill, 1px --divider, --radius, padding --panel-pad (16px at 375, 24px at 1280), no shadow. A panel's first child has margin-top 0 and its last child margin-bottom 0. Bound to .panel, .votes, .feedback, .report-row, .mod, .blocked-account, .feedback-inbox .feedback-message, .comments > form, form[action='/admin/reports'] and dl. Never qualified by article or section, and never added to the pinned '.comments, .feedback, .feedback-inbox {' rule.
states: static: no hover and no focus of its own; its links and controls carry those

components.name: Stat
components.look: .likes, .comment-count and .tally: --text-lg, weight 600, --text, tabular-nums, margin 0. Stats sit side by side with a column gap of --space-5: the votes panel is a wrapping flex row aligned on the baseline, and .tally is inline-block with margin-right --space-5.
states: singular and plural wording come from the markup unchanged

components.name: Notice
components.look:
A block with padding --space-3 --space-4, margin --space-3 0, a 4px left edge, radius 0 --radius-sm --radius-sm 0 and --text text. Never sets display. Variants:
- Neutral (.notice): --surface-2 fill, --text-muted edge.
- Danger (.notice.danger and .error): --danger-soft fill, --danger edge.
- Success (.notice.ok and .feedback-sent): --ok-soft fill, --ok edge.
- Warning (.notice.warning): --warning-soft fill, --warning edge.
states: 'Sent to the author.': not drawn until the URL fragment is #feedback-sent, then the success notice under the form
refused action (p.error role=alert): the danger notice at the top of the admin page, under its links
long message: wraps; the edge runs its full height

components.name: Hint
components.look: Secondary text: --text-sm, --text-muted. Bound to .hint, .meta, .legend, .vote-hint, .comment-hint, .feedback-hint, .feedback-note, .your-vote and .reply-to. Every time element is --text-muted. A link inside a hint stays --link.
states: no interaction; a link inside follows the Link states

components.name: Badge
components.look: An inline-flex pill: padding .0625rem .5rem, --radius-pill, --text-xs, weight 600, letter-spacing .02em, line-height 1.4. Default ('Author'): --accent text on --accent-soft. Danger ('blocked', .feedback-inbox .feedback-message > .byline .badge): --danger text on --danger-soft. No border.
states: static

components.name: Avatar
components.look: A 24px circle (from its width and height attributes), border-radius 50%, --surface-2 placeholder fill, ring box-shadow 0 0 0 1px --divider, object-fit cover, vertical-align middle, flex none. 2rem in a blocked-account heading.
states: image loaded: the photo inside the ring
image missing or refused (alt=''): a plain --surface-2 circle with its ring, never a broken-image glyph

components.name: Byline
components.look: .byline: flex, wrapping, align-items center, gap --space-1 vertical and --space-2 horizontal, --text-sm, line-height --leading-tight, --text-muted. Its items in order: Avatar, then .login (600, --text, overflow-wrap anywhere), then Badge, then time (--text-muted). 'You wrote <time>' uses the same byline.
states: long login: breaks anywhere and the badge and time wrap to the next line
removed comment: no byline, the placeholder instead

components.name: Comment thread
components.look:
Unboxed, on --bg, so no comment wrapper ever gains horizontal padding, border or width.
- .comment: margin 1rem 0.
- Byline, then .body: --text-md --text, margin .25rem 0, pre-wrap, wrapping anywhere, overflow clip.
- The Reply Disclosure; when open, its form holds a Textarea and the Primary 'Post reply' (form margin --space-1 0 --space-3).
- For the owner, the Two-step destructive control.
- The toggle Disclosure ('Hide replies' / 'Show replies').
- .replies is indented .75rem with .5rem padding and a 1px --thread line.
- Placeholder (.removed): --text-sm --text-muted italic.
- At the cap, .cut holds the Continue link 'continue this thread →'.
states: before thread.js: toggles not drawn and every thread open
folded: 'Show replies' with a right chevron and the replies hidden ([hidden])
expanded: 'Hide replies' with a down chevron
reply open: textarea and Post reply under the summary
owner: Remove under Reply; open: the danger tray
removed comment with visible replies: the italic 'comment removed' line, then its replies
depth cap: 'continue this thread →' at tap height
unbroken 300-character body or 39-character login: wraps inside the 244px body at 360
no comments: the inline Empty state 'No comments yet.'

components.name: Feedback message
components.look: Reader side (.own-feedback li.feedback-message): an unbulleted list. Each message has a 1px --divider top edge, padding-top --space-4 and margin-top --space-4, a 'You wrote <time>' Byline and the body. The author's reply (.feedback-reply) is a --surface-2 block with a 3px --accent left edge, radius 0 --radius-sm --radius-sm 0, padding --space-3 --space-4 and margin-top --space-3, holding an Author Badge, a time and the body. Admin side (.feedback-inbox .feedback-message): each message is a Panel with a Byline (avatar, login, a danger 'blocked' Badge, time), its body, its author replies (as above) and a reply form (Textarea plus the Primary 'Send reply', form margin-top --space-3).
states: no own messages: the list is absent
a message with no reply: the body only
one or more author replies: stacked blocks with the accent edge
blocked sender (inbox): the danger 'blocked' badge in the byline
no feedback (inbox): the inline Empty state

components.name: Report frame
components.look: iframe: display block, max-width 100%, 1px --divider edge, --radius, background-color Canvas. Nothing else, ever: no color-scheme, filter, opacity, blend or shadow on the frame or any ancestor below :root. The reader frame (.report-frame) is width 100% of the 70rem column, height 80vh, min-height 24rem. The admin preview takes the same look with its height attribute (600).
states: a report with no background (light): white, exactly as it looks alone
a report with its own dark rule (dark): its own dark background
a light-only report viewed in dark: Chrome's opaque white canvas inside a dark page, as alone
keyboard focus on the frame: the focus ring

components.name: Report card grid
states: title hover: underline
title keyboard focus: the ring
long title: wraps
no publish date: the card ends at the numbers line
one report: a single card in the first column
no reports or unavailable: the page-level Empty state under the legend

components.name: Data table
components.look: table: width 100%, border-collapse separate, border-spacing 0, margin --space-3 0, --surface fill, 1px --divider, --radius, --text-sm, tabular-nums. th and td: padding --space-2 vertical and clamp(.375rem, 1.5vw, .75rem) horizontal, left-aligned, vertical-align top, 1px --divider bottom rule. thead th: --surface-2 fill, --text-xs 600 uppercase at .04em, --text-muted, wrapping only between words (overflow-wrap normal). The top corner cells are rounded at --radius minus 1px, and so are the bottom corners of the last row. The last row has no bottom rule. Body cells inherit overflow-wrap anywhere.
states: row hover: every cell of the row takes --surface-2
link in a cell: Link states
long slug or title: breaks anywhere inside its cell
phone (343px): all five columns stay visible, side padding drops to 6px, headers wrap between words, and the page never scrolls sideways
no rows: the table is absent and the page-level Empty state shows instead

components.name: Detail list
components.look: dl as a Panel: display grid, grid-template-columns max-content minmax(0, 1fr), align-items baseline, gap --space-2 vertical and --space-5 horizontal, max-width 46rem, margin --space-5 0. dt: --text-sm 600 --text-muted. dd: margin 0, min-width 0, overflow-wrap anywhere, tabular-nums, --text.
states: 64-character SHA-256: wraps inside its column (3 lines at 375) and never widens the page
'never' for an unpublished report: plain text

components.name: Plain list
components.look: ul and ol default to padding-left --space-5. The designed lists drop their bullets and padding: .report-list, .own-feedback, .blocked-comments and .blocked-feedback. In the blocked lists each li has padding --space-3 0 and a 1px --divider top edge; its time is display block, --text-sm --text-muted; its span.body is --text; its 'removed' span is the italic muted placeholder; and its Remove is the Two-step destructive control.
states: long list: even separators, no cap
empty: the inline Empty state ('No comments.', 'No feedback.')

components.name: Empty state
components.look:

layout:
html carries --bg.

Header and columns:
- The Site header spans the full width. Its content is inset with padding-inline max(1rem, (100% - 70rem) / 2), so it lines up with the content of the 70rem column at every width.
- main is centred: 72rem at most on the reader pages (main.reader) and the admin pages (main[data-hband-admin]), so 70rem of content inside a literal 1rem gutter; 48rem on any other page (the Not allowed page). Padding is 1.5rem top, 1rem sides, 4rem bottom.
- Wide things take the whole 70rem column: the report frame, the admin preview frame, the admin reports table and the report card grid.
- Reading things are held to a 46rem measure, left-aligned under them: the votes, feedback and comments sections, the legend, admin paragraphs, the upload form (its rows capped at 32rem), the detail list, the inbox, moderation and blocked-account cards.

Vertical rhythm: 32px between page sections and before every h2; 24px before a card's sub-heading and below the meta line; 16px between cards and between form rows; 12px from a textarea to its button; 8px from a label to its field; 4px from a byline to its body.

Phone width: the stylesheet may hold no at-rules, so nothing switches at a breakpoint. What must change does it through wrapping and intrinsic sizing:
- the header's nav wraps under the brand;
- vote buttons, bylines and nav items wrap;
- the card grid falls from three columns at 1280 to one at 375 (auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 20rem), 1fr));
- panel padding goes from 24px to 16px, h1 from 36px to 26px, and table cell side padding from 12px to 6px (each by clamp());
- every long word (logins, slugs, the SHA-256, unbroken comment bodies) breaks anywhere, so nothing widens the page.

At 375 the content is 343px wide and a panel's inside 309px. A level-5 comment keeps 259px (244px at 360). There is no horizontal scroll on any screen.
foundation:
Every visual decision lives in one file, internal/server/static/site.css, served same-origin at /static/site.css (staticFS) under the unchanged siteCSP (style-src 'self'). It is ordered: line 1 `:root { color-scheme: light dark; }`; a second :root holding every token (colours as light-dark(#hex, #hex), type, space, shape); the [hidden]:not(:target) guard; the element baseline; the components bound to today's classes, elements and form actions; and the page parts, including the pinned rule texts. It has no at-rule, so dark mode comes only from light-dark() under color-scheme, which follows the visitor's prefers-color-scheme.

The single <link> to it sits in the "head" partial of internal/layout/templates/base.html, embedded by internal/layout/layout.go (layout.FS). "page-start" (doctype, html, head, the ThreadScript-gated thread.js tag, body, and the consuming set's "header") and "page-end" open and close every page.
- internal/server parses layout.FS and then its own templates through parsePages() in internal/server/router.go. Its header stays the "header" define in internal/server/templates/layout.html.
- internal/auth/owner.go parses layout.FS and then internal/auth/templates/forbidden.html, which defines a brand-only "header".

Every page template takes the look through page-start and page-end, with no own head, no style block and no style attribute: report.html, branch.html, all_reports.html, admin.html, admin_report.html, admin_blocked.html and forbidden.html. comments.html and feedback.html are partials inside report.html and branch.html. A later page gets the look by opening with page-start and closing with page-end, and a later colour is a new light-dark() token in the :root block plus a row in TestStylesheetTokens.
